content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script that derives a 2 m Cartesian grid from eta_00001, loads mean current, significant wave height, and mask fields for selected output numbers, masks dry cells with NaN, plots Hsig as a color field with subsampled current vectors, and overlays fixed sponge and wavemaker boxes and labels (lines 1-67).

equations.ref: x coordinates from eta column count
y coordinates from eta row count

unresolved: Grid dimensions are taken only from eta_00001 at lines 4-10, but u, v, ht, and mask for each fnum are loaded at lines 30-33 and indexed together at lines 35-47 without shape checks. Any output whose dimensions differ from eta_00001 or from its peer fields causes logical-index or plotting dimension failures.
The only image-export command is commented out at line 68, so despite configuring paper size at line 23 the script produces no persistent output file.

Sponge/wavemaker polygons and labels are hard-coded in physical coordinates at lines 12-15 and 50-55; their positions are not derived from input metadata and can lie outside or mislabel grids whose extent differs from this case.
The variable min is defined at line 19 but its sole title use is commented at line 45; nfile can be lengthened independently of min without any active time annotation or validation.
